create_GeomInfo: create a GeomInfo instance with pos, mat, and size arrays for primitive shape collision properties
create_ConvexInfo: create a ConvexInfo instance with pos, mat, size, vert, face, face_normal, edge, and edge_face_normal arrays for convex mesh collision
create_HFieldInfo: create an HFieldInfo instance with pos, mat, size, nrow, ncol, and data arrays for height field collision properties
create_FunctionKey: create a FunctionKey instance with types, data_ids, condim, and optional subgrid_size for collision driver function table lookup
summarize_Collision: summarize the Collision type alias as a tuple of distance, position, and frame arrays returned by collision functions
